description.sub_name: 工具機模組設計與實務
description.sub_ename: MODULE DESIGN AND PRACTICE OF MACHINE TOOL
description.describe_ch: 工具機產業市場競爭激烈，不僅需要在產品上力求創新與快速因應市場需求，因此模組設計在產品設計開發不可或缺的關鍵要素。所以這門課程主要目標是讓學生在工具機產品設計的過程中，學習跨領域的技術，並養成及具備「模組化設計」的基礎理論與技術能力，以達到落地實現「工具機模組化設計」的目標。
description.describe_eh: The machine tool industry is highly competitive, and not only requires innovation and rapid response to market demand in product development, but also considers modular design as an indispensable key element. Therefore, the main objective of this course is to enable students to learn interdisciplinary skills in the process of machine tool product design, and to develop and possess the fundamental theories and technical capabilities of "modular design", in order to achieve the goal of implementing "modular design of machine tools" in practical applications.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解基本工具機的概念

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解工具機進給軸設計、結構配置之基礎原理與概念
targets.describe_en: Understand the basic principles and concepts of machine tool feed shaft design and structural configuration

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解工具機進給軸組裝製程基礎原理與概念(組裝作業、量治具與精度校正)
targets.describe_en: Understand the basic principles and concepts of machine tool feed shaft assembly process (assembly operations, measuring fixtures and accuracy correction)

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解定位精度標準規範、原理及量測之基礎原理與概念
targets.describe_en: Understand the basic principles and concepts of positioning accuracy standard specifications, principles and measurement

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解加工之基礎原理與概念
targets.describe_en: 瞭解加工之基礎原理與概念
